verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting lets users define alert rules across data sources that automatically trigger notifications/actions (Slack, PagerDuty, OpsGenie, Teams) and escalate through on-call/incident workflows, and these rules can be defined as code via provisioning/observability-as-code for automation pipelines. This directly matches 'define rules that trigger actions automatically on events.' Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI agents themselves authoring/managing alert rules end-to-end (vs. humans/CI defining them) and independent hands-on validation of the automation reliability.
